scope.purpose: Restore the smallest independently qualified execution surface that removes the demonstrated blocker and lets the frozen S1 science run again.
recovery_in_scope: conditional SQLite physical batching only if evidence requires it
Sol review and S1 CI-C reauthorization
evolution_out_of_scope: Valkey Streams, NATS JetStream or RocksDB challengers
long-term ephemeral or JIT science runners

frozen_scientific_identity.rule: The S1 scientific manifest and all scientific constants remain frozen throughout RC2-Recovery.
frozen_objects: S1 model and optimizer scientific settings
frozen_scientific_identity.authority_note: This spec references and preserves the existing S1 frozen authority; it does not restate, replace or override it.

hard_invariants.rule: S1 manifest, seeds, tasks, reward, model, optimizer, scientific thresholds, budget and evaluation remain frozen.
Infrastructure failure is never relabeled SCIENTIFIC_FAIL.
Physical write batching must not change account order, replay visibility, learner-update count or order, checkpoint or generation timing, policy-version attribution or provenance.
Message de-duplication is not proof of effective learner-update exactly-once.
Storage-engine, writer-path or commit-protocol code changes create a new implementation identity and require fresh Sol review.
Runtime evidence must come from GitHub Actions -> Shanxi Docker -> durable evidence -> Sol review.

exactly_once_obligations: experience becomes replay-visible at the frozen semantic point
learner update becomes effective exactly once

targets.scope: full frozen S1 CI-C target wall time
targets.note: The existing 360-minute workflow timeout remains only the hard ceiling.

targets.scope: 8-worker production-shaped canary over the final 25 percent of steady state
targets.note: No sustained positive durable-write backlog growth is allowed.

targets.target_backlog: less than or equal to one configured physical batch

targets.note: Fallback to HDD is a contract failure.

targets.scope: required checkpoint and provenance equivalence for the tested fault class

fault_classes.promotion_rule: A PASS for one fault class must not be promoted to a stronger untested class.

scientific_identity_frozen.rule: The S1 scientific manifest is the frozen scientific identity and is unchanged by Recovery.

inheritance_rule.runtime_code_acceptance_inherited_when: R6 was skipped and the accepted S1 runtime code and tree are unchanged
inheritance_rule.runtime_code_acceptance_not_inherited_wh: R6 changes runtime code or any new implementation identity trigger is present

classification_rules.rule: Only when the execution, identity, provenance and evidence contract is complete and all applicable frozen gates pass.
Only when the execution and evidence contract is valid and the frozen scientific criterion fails. Infrastructure or execution failure must never be relabeled SCIENTIFIC_FAIL.
Identity, authorization, profile, storage-placement, provenance or contract mismatch; fail closed.
Authorized execution surface, host session or external dependency is unavailable.
Hardware capability or capacity prevents execution or qualification.
A required metric, artifact or proof could not be measured or retained; this is not PASS.

verdict_taxonomy.precedence_rule: Contract-invalid conditions must not be downgraded into SCIENTIFIC_FAIL.

rules: A task receipt must bind the exact head SHA and tree SHA it reports.
Any host change requires a versioned before/after machine-readable receipt produced by the authorized executor.
GitHub Actions runtime evidence must bind the exact checkout SHA and tree; ancestor CI does not validate descendant code.
Host observations alone are not runtime qualification evidence.
Missing mandatory receipt or proof yields EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT or CONTRACT_MISMATCH according to the gate, never PASS.
scientific_constants_changed must be false for every Recovery task.

R21_RC2_RECOVERY_SPEC_V1.content: Machine-readable Recovery contract covering task registry, PERF-RC2-V1, fault classes, identity rules, required receipts/artifacts and verdict taxonomy.

R1_RUNNER_DEFINITION_V1.content: Versioned runner image/build definition and uid/gid ownership contract.

R1_LAUNCH_PROFILE_V1.content: Versioned launch/profile definition including mount and storage-class declarations and shared-memory declaration.

R1_RUNNER_IMAGE_IDENTITY_V1.content: Exact runner/image identity bound to the versioned definition.

R1_SANITIZED_SNAPSHOT_GENERATOR_V1.content: Read-only sanitized snapshot generator that does not read secret values.

R1_REPRODUCTION_GATE_RECEIPT_V1.content: Evidence that a disposable or recovery runner created from repo definitions reproduces the declared contract and passes Shanxi preflight.

R2_SSD_CAPACITY_INVENTORY_V1.content: Machine-readable SSD total, used and free capacity inventory collected under read-only host authorization.

R2_PROTECTED_KEEP_LIST_V1.content: Protected and keep list with explicit rationale.

R2_RECLAIM_CANDIDATES_V1.content: Reclaim candidates and sizes; no cleanup is authorized by this artifact.

R2_FAST_HOT_PROVISION_PROPOSAL_V1.content: Proposed FAST_HOT quota, required free-space reserve and expected before/after capacity.

R2_OWNER_APPROVAL_V1.content: Owner approval of the concrete capacity and provision plan; required before R3.

R3_TASK_LOCAL_CHANGE_PLAN_V1.content: Exact intended host and container changes, target components, rollback path and out-of-scope statement before execution.

R3_PRE_CHANGE_SNAPSHOT_V1.content: Versioned sanitized before-change snapshot of the affected host and container configuration.

R3_POST_CHANGE_HOST_RECEIPT_V1.content: Versioned after-change receipt binding exact host/container operations to the approved plan.

R3_RUNNER_PROFILE_IDENTITY_V1.content: Exact repo-defined image/profile identity, dedicated R21 runner identity and label, FAST_HOT mount and 2 GiB shared-memory identity.

R3_SHANXI_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1.content: GitHub Actions Shanxi evidence proving profile identity, write permissions, shared-memory size, non-rotational FAST_HOT placement and protected-input read-only status.

R3_ROLLBACK_REFERENCE_V1.content: Record that the current R11 runner remains available as rollback and reference.

R4_WRITE_PATH_INVENTORY_V1.content: Measured S1-shaped write paths covering replay, SQLite, update journal, checkpoints, generation-switch receipts, provenance and artifact staging.

R4_DEVICE_TELEMETRY_V1.content: Device telemetry artifact supporting the measured read/write and durability claims.

R4_MEASUREMENT_ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY_V1.content: Exact runtime, profile, device and filesystem identity for the measurement environment.

R5_PLACEMENT_CANARY_IDENTITY_V1.content: Identity of the accepted S1 runtime, runner profile and FAST_HOT surface used by the placement-only canary.

R5_SEMANTIC_PROVENANCE_EQUIVALENCE_V1.content: Semantic and provenance equivalence result against the accepted bounded canary.

R5_PERF_RC2_V1_RESULTS_V1.content: Applicable PERF-RC2-V1 metric results with explicit measured evidence.

R5_FAST_HOT_DEVICE_PROOF_V1.content: Machine evidence that every FAST_HOT surface resolves to non-rotational storage.

R5_BACKLOG_EVIDENCE_V1.content: Backlog over the final 25 percent of steady state and post-producer drain evidence.

R5_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_INDEX_V1.content: Retained failure artifacts and machine-readable index.

R6_NEW_IMPLEMENTATION_CANDIDATE_V1.content: New exact-SHA implementation candidate for conditional SQLite physical batching.

R6_EQUIVALENCE_SUITE_V1.content: Event/order, replay-visibility, effective-update exactly-once, checkpoint/generation, policy-generation attribution, provenance reconstruction and retry/recovery idempotence equivalence suite.

R6_EXACT_SHA_CI_EVIDENCE_V1.content: GitHub Actions to Shanxi Docker evidence bound to the new implementation SHA and tree.

R6_SOL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW_V1.content: Independent Sol implementation review before R7.

R7_PROCESS_RECOVERY_RECEIPT_V1.content: Process-level restart, replay and idempotence recovery receipt under GitHub Actions.

R7_CONTAINER_RECOVERY_RECEIPT_V1.content: Container-level recovery receipt produced through the task-limited authorized host restart boundary.

R7_ARTIFACT_ONLY_PROVENANCE_RECEIPT_V1.content: Artifact-only reconstruction and provenance verification receipt.

R7_HOSTILE_CORRUPTION_RECEIPT_V1.content: Hostile intermediate-link corruption result proving fail-closed behavior.

R7_FAILURE_EVIDENCE_INDEX_V1.content: Failure evidence retained and indexed for the tested fault class.

R8_SOL_REVIEW_RECORD_V1.content: Sol review record of repo diff, runner/profile identity, host-change receipts, R4/R5 evidence, any R6 implementation, R7 evidence and frozen performance gates.

R8_S1_CI_C_REAUTHORIZATION_V1.content: S1 CI-C reauthorization binding the accepted runtime identity to the qualified R21 execution surface.

task_registry.title: Freeze Recovery authority, performance and fault contract
task_registry.purpose: Deliver a versioned machine-readable Recovery contract covering task registry, PERF-RC2-V1 targets, fault classes, scientific-versus-implementation identity rules, required receipts and artifacts, and verdict taxonomy.

owner_approval.note: No owner approval required for a repository-only contract freeze.

task_registry.gate: Spec is machine-readable, self-consistent with R21 RC2 TODO V2 and accepted by Sol Reviewer before R1 starts.
task_registry.scope_boundary: No host session, no runtime code change, no workflow change and no S1 scientific change.

task_registry.title: Version and reproduce current runner definition
task_registry.purpose: Version the runner image/build definition, launch/profile definition, uid/gid contract, mount and storage-class declarations, shared-memory declaration, runner/image identity and sanitized snapshot generator.

owner_approval.note: Read-only host session is explicitly required and must stay read-only; this is session authorization, not host-change owner approval.

task_registry.gate: A disposable or recovery runner created from repo definitions reproduces the declared contract and passes Shanxi preflight; the live runner is not changed.
task_registry.scope_boundary: Read-only host inspection only; must not change the live runner.

task_registry.title: SSD capacity, reserve, protected list and provision proposal
task_registry.purpose: Produce a machine-readable SSD capacity inventory, protected/keep list, reclaim candidates, proposed FAST_HOT quota, required free-space reserve and expected before/after capacity.

owner_approval.note: R3 is blocked until the owner approves the concrete R2 capacity and provision proposal.

task_registry.gate: Inventory and provision proposal are complete and an owner approval record exists before R3.
task_registry.scope_boundary: R2 does not authorize cleanup, formatting, repartitioning or any other host change.

task_registry.title: Parallel Recovery runner plus FAST_HOT
task_registry.purpose: Provision a parallel R21 Recovery runner with approved SSD-backed FAST_HOT storage, correct runner write ownership, versioned 2 GiB shared memory, protected read-only inputs, dedicated runner identity and exact repo-defined image/profile identity.

owner_approval.note: The owner must approve the exact task-local host and container changes before execution.

task_registry.gate: GitHub Actions on the new R21 runner proves profile identity, write permissions, 2 GiB shared-memory size, non-rotational FAST_HOT placement and protected-input read-only status.
task_registry.scope_boundary: Only the parallel R21 Recovery runner and its named components; retain the current R11 runner as rollback and reference; unrelated host services and storage are out of scope.

task_registry.title: Measure actual S1-shaped write path
task_registry.purpose: Instrument one bounded S1-shaped run and produce measured per-surface write-path facts.

owner_approval.note: A read-only host session is allowed only when device telemetry cannot be collected from the runner.

task_registry.gate: R5 and R6 decisions cite measured surfaces rather than assumptions; required fields are present or the result is EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT.
task_registry.scope_boundary: No host change and no science-semantic change.

task_registry.title: Placement-only accepted-runtime canary
task_registry.purpose: Run the already accepted S1 runtime unchanged on the qualified R21 Recovery execution surface and decide whether R6 is needed.

owner_approval.note: Read-only host telemetry is allowed only if needed; no host change.

task_registry.gate: Semantic and provenance equivalence pass, applicable PERF-RC2-V1 targets hold, every FAST_HOT surface is non-rotational, there is no sustained backlog growth and failure artifacts are retained.
decision_rule: If R5 meets all targets with headroom, skip R6 and proceed to R7.
If R5 is correct but misses a target, Sol reviews R4 and R5 before opening R6 or an alternate targeted task.
task_registry.scope_boundary: Accepted S1 runtime code remains unchanged; only placement and execution-surface configuration may differ.

task_registry.title: Conditional SQLite physical batching
task_registry.purpose: If and only if measured evidence identifies SQLite transaction or durability frequency as a material bottleneck, implement bounded physical batching without changing semantic batching.
task_registry.open_trigger: R4 or R5 measured evidence shows SQLite transaction or durability frequency remains a material bottleneck; Sol explicitly opens R6.

owner_approval.note: Sol authority gates task opening; no blanket owner approval is implied.

equivalence_obligations: exactly one effective learner update at every frozen update boundary
task_registry.gate: New exact-SHA implementation candidate is independently reviewed and accepted by Sol Reviewer before R7.
task_registry.scope_boundary: Physical write batching must not be treated as semantic event batching or learner-update batching.

task_registry.title: Recovery, restart and provenance qualification
task_registry.purpose: Qualify only the failure classes actually tested, including process-level and task-limited container-level recovery, effective-update exactly-once and artifact-only provenance reconstruction.

owner_approval.note: Only the R21 Recovery components named in the task-local plan are in scope for the external container restart boundary; task-limited host authorization is required.

task_registry.gate: Semantic equivalence, effective-update exactly-once, artifact-only provenance reconstruction, applicable performance and latency gates, storage and profile identity and failure-evidence retention all pass for the tested fault class.
task_registry.scope_boundary: A container-level PASS must not be promoted to HOST_REBOOT or POWER_LOSS.

task_registry.title: Sol review and S1 CI-C reauthorization
task_registry.purpose: Independently review the Recovery evidence and bind the accepted or new runtime identity to the qualified R21 execution surface.

owner_approval.note: Reviewer-owned; DS does not self-certify or merge.

task_registry.gate: Sol accepts the repo diff, runner/profile identity, host-change receipts, R4/R5 evidence, any R6 implementation, R7 evidence and frozen performance gates; only then may PR #102 leave execution-frozen state and formal S1 CI-C be dispatched again.
task_registry.scope_boundary: Sol review and authorization only; DS implementation remains frozen until reauthorization.

blocking_gates.condition: R0 spec accepted as the Recovery contract.
Owner approves the exact R2 SSD capacity and FAST_HOT provision proposal.
Sol explicitly opens R6 after reviewing measured R4/R5 evidence.
New R6 implementation SHA and tree are accepted before R7 if R6 was opened.
Task-limited host change authorization exists for the named R21 Recovery component.
R8 review is accepted and S1 CI-C reauthorization is issued.

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not lower the S1 scientific budget.
Do not reduce frozen S1 seeds.
Do not delete durable journal or provenance data.
Do not weaken fsync or durability semantics.
Do not change S1 sampling, reward, thresholds, model or optimizer.
Do not declare success because a one-worker run eventually finishes.
Do not treat adding workers as a rescue for the HDD bottleneck.
Do not repeatedly launch the same formal campaign on the same spindle as useful evidence.
Do not perform host mutation before owner approval of the exact R2 proposal.
Do not implement Valkey, JetStream and RocksDB in parallel without an evidence trigger.
Do not self-certify Sol acceptance or merge.
Do not relabel infrastructure failure as SCIENTIFIC_FAIL.
Do not allow a hidden FAST_HOT fallback to HDD.
stop_conditions: Any host action not explicitly authorized by the current task must stop as EXECUTION_BLOCKED.
A required metric that cannot be measured must be reported as EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT, not PASS.
Any identity, authorization, profile or provenance mismatch must fail closed as CONTRACT_MISMATCH.
If the execution and evidence contract is invalid, a science-gate failure must not be reported as SCIENTIFIC_FAIL.
R6 remains closed unless Sol opens it from measured evidence.
HOST_REBOOT and POWER_LOSS must not be claimed unless separately authorized and tested.
DS terminal state is READY_FOR_SOL_REVIEW; DS does not issue PASS, acceptance or merge.

evidence_rules.evidence_path: GitHub Actions -> authorized Shanxi Docker execution surface -> durable artifacts/receipts -> Sol review
